title: Chapter 9 The Lord'S World
content:
Chapter 9 The Lord'S World

"But what you said makes sense. The mysterious enemy in the forest is stronger than we thought, as it has allowed so many good men of our tribe to return to the embrace of the spirit god."

"Send your strongest scout to check the situation. If it is impossible, we will withdraw to the camp and wait for follow-up reinforcements."

Since the white-robed priest learned that the people killed by Wu Qing would disappear out of thin air, he has been eager to catch Wu Qing. Mysterious figures like Wu Qing are his favorites for believing in gods.

In order to catch Wu Qing, he even delayed this combat mission.

As long as Wu Qing is caught and the sacrifice to the gods is successful, he can ascend to heaven in one step.

The white-robed priest wanted to take the credit for himself, but now he found that it seemed a bit difficult.

More than 300 warriors were sent into the forest, but there was no wave. He dared not take any more risks.

"Yes! Lord Priest!"

The knight obeyed the order and sent scouts to sneak into the forest to find out the situation of the location where the signal was sent.

In the forest full of puppies, the scouts he sent out would of course never return.

Wu Qing was sending out his troops at full strength, preparing for a large-scale war of attrition. Unexpectedly, the fearless greenskins hesitated and began to retreat.

"You still have some brains, otherwise we would all be buried here."

In Wu Qing's plan, this battle had to be fought sooner or later, it was just a matter of early or late.

If he fought early now, Wu Qing would have to fight for consumption. If he fought later, the strength of the Zerg would only become stronger and stronger. If the greenskins did not have strong reinforcements in a short time, they would have no chance of survival.

Wu Qing continued to send out the dogs to explore everywhere. He and the greenskins had become mortal enemies now. He had to find the other force as soon as possible and find out the news.

What you think will come true.

A pair of puppies soon discovered other intelligent creatures besides the greenskins.

Wu Qing switched to the perspective of the dogs and saw a man in simple leather armor, carrying a short bow and a short sword sneaking.

This man had two notable features. He had a pair of furry pointed ears and a big furry tail.

"Fox spirit? Fox tribe?"

When Wu Qing came to this world, no one he met was a normal human.

"This should be a scout from another camp. The system threw me into their camp at the beginning. There must be a reason. I can talk to him."

Wu Qing left the Zerg territory and ran to the target person's location.

The biological colonization suit on his body changed to a strong style suitable for walking in the jungle as he wished, and the long spear in his hand also turned into a short sword with a sheath.

10 puppies and two hydralisks ran over and followed him. In this large forest, there were many puppies he sent out, which could act as eyes to deal with emergencies.

The target of the scout suspected of being a fox spirit was the camp of the greenskins. Not long after, he found a suitable position in the forest, lurked and observed the movements of the greenskins.

At this time, the greenskin army was still stationed at the edge of the forest and had not withdrawn to the camp. There were about 600 people.

The fox spirit scout quietly observed the greenskins, but he didn't know that there were several pairs of eyes observing him.

"Surround him, but don't hurt him."

Wu Qing ordered the puppies around him to start moving.

When the puppies formed a circle, Wu Qing stood up from his hiding place and walked towards the fox spirit scout.

The movement of Wu Qing attracted the attention of the fox spirit scout, who instantly put an arrow on the bow and pointed the short bow in the direction of Wu Qing.

"Don't be nervous, I have no ill intentions!"

Wu Qing put his hands in a conspicuous position to show his friendliness.

The system gave him the ability to understand languages. The language of this world is not much different from his mother tongue to him.

"Put down your weapons, I don't want to hurt you."

The puppies lurking around slowly revealed their ferocious figures.

Seeing this, the fox spirit scout's hand trembled and almost shot the arrow out.

Looking around, the fox spirit scout knew that he was powerless to resist, so he put down the short bow tactfully and asked cautiously: "Are you human?"

"Yes."

"What are these?"

The fox spirit scout looked at the puppies again.

"These are my companions, you can call them Zerg."

"So you are friends of the human race and the Zerg race, how come you are here?"

The fox spirit scout may have seen a lot of strange races, he does not reject creatures like Zerg race.

"It's a long story, let's get to know each other again, I am Wu Qing from the human race."

Wu Qing extended his hand to show his friendliness, he didn't know the etiquette of this world, he could only test it.

"Nice to meet you, I am a fox from the demon race, my name is Hu Tu."

For some reason unknown to Wu Qing, Hu Tu quickly let down his guard, extended his hand in a friendly manner, and shook hands with Wu Qing.

The two eliminated their hostility, Wu Qing had a lot of questions to ask, he sorted out his thoughts, found a clean place, and asked Hu Tu to sit down.

Then he asked: "For some reasons, my Zerg friends and I have been living in an isolated place. We know nothing about the outside world. I have some questions to ask you."

"No problem. Now the living space of our native race is getting smaller and smaller. There are many people like you. Of course, we should help each other when we meet."

Hu Tu agreed very readily. From his words, Wu Qing also got some important information.

"Thank you very much! Then please introduce me to the situation in the outside world."

"You're welcome. I only know some common sense."

Hu Tu is a talkative person. He began to introduce some common sense of this world to Wu Qing.

As the two asked and answered, this world gently unveiled a mysterious veil in front of Wu Qing.

In this world, I don't know when it started. Many strange races appeared. They all believed in some foreign gods and were fanatical about conquering this world.

The local creatures were unwilling to be enslaved by foreign gods and races, so they rose up in resistance and the two sides fought for countless years.

The foreign races believed in foreign gods, and their beliefs were extremely fanatical, almost to the point of dementia, which was also the reason why the local creatures rejected them.

But this belief made these foreign races powerful and gradually gained the upper hand in the war between the two sides.

Over the years, those local creatures who were conquered by foreign gods and races believed in foreign gods and were also considered foreign races.

In this way, one side continued to weaken and the other side continued to strengthen. Now, the situation of the local races is very bad.

This is just one aspect of this world.

What's more terrifying is that the creatures in this world have to face another terrifying thing, that is, the weirdness that Wu Qing encountered at night.

The weirdness in this world is everywhere, mainly appearing at night, with various forms and hard to guard against. Ordinary people have no way to survive in such an environment.

This world has not completely abandoned native creatures, but also provides a way to solve the influence of weirdness, so that ordinary people can reproduce.

This way is to obtain the authority of the lord of this world and build a territory. The territory can protect the people from the influence of weirdness within a certain range.

In this world, without the lord, there is no space for ordinary people to survive.

It is no exaggeration to say that this is a world of lords!
